{{Top}}
[[File:Clone_Wars_Sector_Armies.png|thumb|right|250px|Areas of operations of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] sector armies in the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
A '''Sector Army''' was a type of military formation used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and, later, the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], although the role and composition of these units evolved markedly between the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Sector Armies in the Clone Wars==
In the Clone Wars, Sector Armies were the main subordinate component units of the ten [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] that formed the military backbone of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. There were two Sector Armies in each Systems Army, making a total of twenty Sector Armies; each of them was commanded by a [[Senior Jedi General]], and had a nominal combat strength of 147,456 troopers, divided into four Corps (although it should also be noted that many of the [[Legion/Legends|Legions]] which made up the Corps also included "Corps" within their unit names). Under the "[[1/4/16/64 Plan]]," one corps was maintained as a mobile reserve force while the others were theoretically divided into progressively smaller units so that one army could fulfill one corps operation, four [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-level operations, sixteen [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]]-level operations or sixty-four [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]-level operations. In reality, sector army deployments were rarely so neat, and typically one corps in each army remained intact, but the others were divided into hundreds of small, fast-moving raiding companies.<ref name="EGW" />

The twenty [[Oversector/Legends|oversectors]] created by the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] matched the Sector Armies' theaters of operations. The decree gave twenty of the new [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] responsibility for supporting the Sector Armies. This system also freed them from having to constantly consult local authorities.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Sector Armies under the Empire==
{{Main|Sector army}}
After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], oversectors were reorganized as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] militarization. This sectors and the Sector Armies were placed under the authority of a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]].<ref name="TEA" /> Notably, following [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]], the positions of sector armies and systems armies in the military hierarchy were reversed: [[Systems army|systems armies]] were now subordinate commands to sector armies.

Under the New Order, the number of Sector Armies rose dramatically; each of the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], the Governors who [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] dispatched to oversee the thousand [[Sector/Legends|Sectors]] which the Empire had inherited from the Old Republic, bore the title of [[Surface Marshal]] of a Sector Army. And each of these Sector Armies could serve in turn as the high command for an Assault Fleet capable of deploying four full surface [[Army/Legends|Armies]] against any resistance or hostility in the sector - 774,576 combat troops in a total muster of 1,180,379 personnel - to say nothing of a number of autonomous [[Corps/Legends#Corps_HQs|Corps HQs]] for garrison duty.

==List of Sector Armies under the Clone Wars and early Imperial Period==
===Reserve Sector Armies===
"Reserve" Sectors was the term given by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to its first six Sector Armies. Headquartered in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the six sector armies were officially designated as reserve commands, but they act in a variety of roles.

*The [[First Army|1st Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. Also known as Azure Hammer Command.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. Also known as Green Mantle Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Third Mid Rim Army|3rd Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Also known as Steel Blade Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Also known as White Cuirass Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Fifth Deep Core Army|5th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Odik II|Odik]]. Also known as Shadow Hand Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Sixth Negative Regions|6th Sector Army]], stationed at [[Praxlis system/Legends|Praxlis]]. Also known as Black Sword Command.<ref name="EGW" />

===Northern Campaign Sector Armies===
The Northern Campaign Sector Armies were the Grand Army of the Republic's six Sector Armies that were assigned to the northern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Sector Armies 7-12 made up the [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] [[Systems Army Delta|Delta]], [[Systems Army Epsilon|Epsilon]], and [[Systems Army Zeta|Zeta]], the three Systems Armies that were assigned primarily to the northern quadrant.

*The [[Seventh Army|7th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. Also known as the [[Immalia Oversector|Immalia Sector]] Army or Golden Nyss Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Eighth Army|8th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Also known as the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Ord Mantell Sector]] Army or Bright Jewel Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Ninth Army|9th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Paarin Minor]]. Also known as the [[Relgim Oversector|Relgim Sector]] Army or Brazen Petard Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Tenth Army|10th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Also known as the [[Quelii Oversector|Quelii Sector]] Army or Crimson Dagger Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Eleventh Army|11th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Korphir]]. Also known as the [[Gordian Reach Oversector|Gordian Reach Sector]] Army or Blazing Claw Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]], stationed at [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]]. Also known as the [[Maldrood Oversector/Legends|Maldrood Sector]] Army or Cerulean Spear Command.<ref name="EGW" />

===Southern Campaign Sector Armies===
The Southern Campaign Sector Armies were the Grand Army of the Republic's eight Sector Armies that were assigned to the southern quadrant of the galaxy during the Clone Wars.

*The [[Thirteenth Army|13th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]]. Also known as the [[Trans-Nebular Oversector|Trans-Nebular Sector]] Army or Iron Lance Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Fourteenth Army|14th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Also known as the [[Tolonda Oversector/Legends|Tolonda Sector]] Army or Red Tails Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Fifteenth Army|15th Sector Army]], headquartered in the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet system]]. Also known as the [[Sarin Oversector|Sarin Sector]] Army or [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Sixteenth Army|16th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Chardaan/Legends|Chardaan]]. Also known as the [[Pallis Oversector|Pallis Sector]] Army or Ivory Fang Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Seventeenth Army|17th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Vogel 7]]. Also known as the [[Dustig Oversector|Dustig Sector]] Army or Chrome Shield Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Eighteenth Army|18th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. Also known as the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Seswenna Sector]] Army or Night Hammer Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Nineteenth Army|19th Sector Army]], headquartered at [[Javin]]. Also known as the [[Javin Oversector|Javin Sector]] Army or Dark Saber Command.<ref name="EGW" />
*The [[Twentieth Army|20th Sector Army]], stationed at [[Tallaan]]. Also known as the [[Tapani Oversector|Tapani Sector]] Army or Emerald Banner Command.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sector Armies were introduced as elements of the Imperial Army in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', and retrospectively given their Clone Wars back-story only in the ''[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]''. In the ''Imperial Sourcebook'', the most obvious reading of the text is that a Sector Army is divided for administrative purposes into two [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] and represented in combat by four front-line [[Army/Legends|Armies]] and an associated Navy [[Assault fleet|Assault Fleet]]; but this enumeration cannot represent the entire order of battle of a standard Sector Army, as it omits the [[Corps/Legends#Corps HQs|Corps HQs]] and combat battalions of planetary garrison, each of which was designed as the basis to build up a new combat [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] on a world when required. It is very possible that the number of Systems Armies, surface Armies, front-line Corps and garrison details in a Sector Army should be thought of as varying markedly from sector to sector.

The ''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]'' implied that the Rebels had their own Sector Armies, citing that the most senior Generals commanded them.
